label: Variables standardization
detail:
Whether all covariates and the proximal outcome provided to the personalization algorithm are approximately standardized (so average value of each standardized covariate/proximal outcome is roughly close to 0 and the standard deviation of each standardized covariate/proximal outcome is roughly 1).

**Note:** once the algorithm is deployed, the proximal outcome Y must be standardized with the *same* mean and variance used in the original MRT analysis. Do not recalculate them from post-deployment data.

label: Method Determination
detail: There are two ways to set the prior for the intercept, α~0~. They differ in how much work they take and how closely the prior is tailored to your own intervention design.

label: Stop 😵
detail: Standardize each covariate and the proximal outcome before setting priors: subtract its sample mean in the MRT data and divide by its sample standard deviation. Then come back to this page.
